differences.detail: in the reproduction, the ORT runtime files sit one directory too deep (spa/wake-runtime/wake-runtime/, spa/vad-runtime/vad-runtime/), with extra nested vditor and porcupine copies. Cause: setup-release-checkout.sh provisions gitignored public/ assets with `cp -al || cp -a`. Across filesystems, cp -al fails after creating the destination, and cp -a then nests. Confirmed with a cross-FS vs same-FS scratch test. The shipped reference is NOT affected (same filesystem). verify-sidecar-bundle and the identity audit passed the broken tree

verdict.summary: The operator payload (serve.mjs, mcp-proxy.mjs) reproduces byte-for-byte from the pinned source in a separate checkout on a different path and filesystem. 14078 of the 14085 files present in both trees are identical. Of the 7 that differ: 3 are timestamps, 2 are Rust build-path binaries (inferred), 1 is a live-flag snapshot and 1 (db-seed.dump) is unclassified. The file-set differences are two checkout-provisioning defects (WI-10004073, WI-10004074) plus later cut steps outside this rebuild's scope.
